title: Yallapp app build config
description: Everything needed to build one client's app. The platform writes it from the setup wizard; the build pipeline and the Flutter app read it. Secrets (signing keys, store API keys) are never part of this file.

client_id.description: The platform's client ID, for logs.

app_type.description: Which module the build includes: 'lms' (Academy), 'store' (WooCommerce), 'booking' (Amelia, BookingPress or LatePoint), 'real_estate' (property listings on the hosted API), 'news' (articles from WordPress, an own API, a feed or the dashboard), 'events' (events and tickets on the hosted API) or 'donations' (charity campaigns and donations on the hosted API).

vertical.description: Optional. The kind of business, on top of app_type: it changes wording and defaults in the app, never which module or screens it has. Left out for apps without one; apps treat an unknown value as none.

site_url.description: The client's WordPress site. The app calls <site_url>/wp-json/yallapp/v1.

api_base_url.description: Optional. Where the app finds the Yallapp API, for sites without WordPress (a custom API or the hosted API). Defaults to <site_url>/wp-json/yallapp/v1.

auth_base_url.description: Optional. For an app on its own API that Yallapp signs people in to: Yallapp's hosted API for the app, https://yallapp.com.tr/api/app/{app_id}. The app sends sign-in, account and device calls there (Config.auth.provider 'yallapp'), and every other call to api_base_url with Yallapp's access token. Left out when the API at api_base_url signs people in.

logo_url.description: PNG or SVG shown on the sign-in screen.

firebase.description: Optional. Push notifications are off when missing.

analytics.description: Optional. 44 Where the app sends its usage statistics (docs/api/platform.yaml, tag Analytics): Yallapp's endpoint for this app and the app's analytics key. Left out of the app preview's config; without it the app sends nothing.

key.description: Sent as X-Yallapp-Analytics-Key. Not a secret: it is the same in every copy of the app.

huawei.description: Optional. 36 Huawei Push Kit, for Android phones without Google Play services (Huawei AppGallery). Without it those phones get no push notifications and the build leaves Huawei's SDK out.
